records.title: OPERATIONAL STATUS OF NAVIC CONSTELLATION
details:
(d) NVS-03 is ready for launch. It will be followed by the launch of NVS-04 and NVS-05. 
One more satellite is planned thereafter to complete the seven-satellite NavIC base 
layer constellation.
